top3.whyItMatters: Daily growth on agentic tasks shows how fast teams switch models once one proves itself.

top3.whyItMatters: Teams running many agents need one place to see and steer their work.

top3.whyItMatters: Plan rules, not model quality, may decide which coding tools your team can use.

items.title: Pocock: Vercel Board is a shared workspace for agents and developers
items.takeaway: Matt Pocock describes Vercel Board as a private Slack-like workspace for agents and developers that can sync to Slack channels. He thinks most teams should build something like it.
items.soWhat: Give agents and people one shared channel so their work stays visible.

items.title: Perplexity says Gemini 4 Neon use grows 15% a day in Computer
items.takeaway: Aravind Srinivas reports Gemini 4 Neon usage on Perplexity up 10.6% a day in Ask and 15.0% a day in Computer, Nov 19 to 22. Perplexity's own data.
items.soWhat: Usage data from a model-neutral product hints at where agentic work is moving.

items.title: Alex Finn runs Inkling 2 Mini on a laptop around the clock
items.takeaway: Alex Finn says Inkling 2 Mini runs on a MacBook Pro using under half its memory, coding and scraping the web 24/7. He claims Opus 4.6 level coding; a self-report with no benchmark.
items.soWhat: Local models may cut costs for always-on agent work; test before you trust the claim.

items.title: Alexandr Wang: the current AI path is not inevitable
items.takeaway: Alexandr Wang says the current AI path is not inevitable and leadership matters more than ever, citing safety work at Meta. He notes leaders of other labs have said much the same.
items.soWhat: Lab leaders are framing AI's direction as a leadership choice, not a given.

items.title: Theo: Gemini subscriptions work only inside Google's Antigravity
items.takeaway: Theo says a Gemini subscription can only be used in Antigravity. T3 Code routing through the Antigravity binary to Google's API is allowed; other harnesses such as Pi are not.
items.soWhat: Check plan terms before standardizing your team on a coding harness.

items.title: Nikita Bier: agents that cancel subscriptions could reshape banking
items.takeaway: Nikita Bier argues the economy rests on people not cancelling subscriptions or moving cash to higher-yield accounts. If everyone ran an agent to do it, banking would shift. Opinion, no data.
items.soWhat: Business models built on customer inertia are exposed once agents act for customers.

items.title: Srinivas pitches Perplexity as a model-neutral agent harness
items.takeaway: Aravind Srinivas calls Perplexity the best model-neutral agentic harness, compatible with the best frontier models, with all primitives exposed in code mode. A CEO's claim.
items.soWhat: A model-neutral harness lets you swap models without rebuilding your agent setup.

items.title: Tavi Costa: India's silver imports hit third-highest value on record
items.takeaway: Tavi Costa notes India reported its third-highest silver import value on record and frames it as a shift from leveraged traders to long-term owners.
items.soWhat: He reads the buying as long-term ownership, not short-term trading.
